name: Lizard

abilityDetails.Retribution: Etkilenen şampiyon özel saldırı kullandığında, özel saldırı bitene kadar tüm kaynaklardan artan hasar alır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Fervor: Giden hasar veren etkilerin yetenek doğruluğunu artırır.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Node'a çok bağımlı bir savunmacı. Aldığı hasarın %65'ini pasif iyileştirir (garanti kritikleri iyileştiremez, doğrudan/sürekli hasarı da iyileştiremez) — iyileşme engeli tercih et. Özel saldırılarında 4'e kadar retribution uygular (özel saldırı hasarının %80'ini geri verir) — sürekli hasar veren node'larda bu ciddi sorun. Bonus nötralize eder veya immünse pasif durdurulamaz olur.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Science sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:

immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• İyileşme Engeli Bağışıklığı (Buff veya Durdurulamaz varken) 💚🚫

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Immune to Poison, and Immune to Heal Block while under the effect of a Buff or an Unstoppable effect.
Lizard's Regeneration Rate can only be reduced below 50% by Skill Champions.

abilitySections.title: Lizard Healing Factor
content: When struck, gain a Regeneration Passive that recovers 60% of the damage taken over 20 seconds. Guaranteed Critical Hits do not trigger this Regeneration.
When inflicted by an Incinerate, Coldsnap, or Frostbite effect by a Skill Champion, lose one Regeneration effect.

abilitySections.title: Rending Claws
content: All of Lizard's attacks have a 25% chance to inflict a [1,007.1] Rupture Debuff for 6 seconds. Max stacks: 20.

When the Opponent activates a Special Attack, for each Physical or Direct Damage Over Time effect on them (excluding effects from Masteries), deal a burst of [3,826.98] Physical Damage. This damage scales with Base Attack only, but scales up with the level of Special Attack used, and the Opponent's current Power on activation.
Personal Ruptures have a 50% chance to be removed when they trigger this burst of damage.
Striking a non-Stunned Opponent with a Heavy Attack pauses all personal Debuffs on the Opponent for 15 seconds. This effect does not trigger if the Opponent was Stunned during any of the hits.
Intercepting the Opponent or Punishing their Heavy or Special Attacks inflicts a Tracking Debuff for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: For the duration of his own Special Attacks, Lizard is Buff Immune.
Each Special Attack hit that hits, is Blocked, or Whiffs inflicts a 20% Retribution Passive, lasting 12 seconds per level of the Special Attack, and is paused during Special Attacks. Max stacks: 4.
If the Opponent Dodges a hit, Retribution is not inflicted.
While these Retributions are within 6 seconds of expiring, the Opponent is more likely to activate a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Primal Rage
content: When Immune to a Buff or when a Buff on Lizard is Nullified or Staggered, gain an Unstoppable Passive for 3 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. As an Attacker, if Lizard is struck while this Unstoppable is active, it starts a 10 second cooldown.
While this Unstoppable is active, gain an Unblockable Passive and +[8,560.35] Attack Rating.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a non-stacking 8.33% Rejuvenate Passive for 20 seconds. While this effect is active gain +[6,042.6] Attack Rating.
On activation, gain a non-stacking 100% Fervor Passive for 20 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 and 3
content: The final hit deals a burst of Physical Damage equal to 125% of all the damage the Opponent has taken during their own Special Attacks, up to a max of [201,420] damage. Damage counting resets once the damage is dealt.
Special Attack 3 deals an extra burst of this Physical Damage, equal to 55% of the damage the Opponent has taken.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Reptilian Complex
content: Increase the potency of personal Retributions by [5 - 25]%.
Gain +[70.5 - 485.29] Block Proficiency.
While the Opponent has at least 2 Bars of Power, they are inflicted with a 100% Wither Debuff.
